absent: The numeric value for PCI_DEVICE_ID_S3_SAVAGE4 itself does not appear in the routed lines, which show only later Intel identifiers.
Numeric values for trailing plus sids from HDA_LKF onward through NETMOS_9705 are not shown in the visible part of the third fragment.
No locking rules, synchronization or concurrency contracts appear in these constant definitions.
No struct layouts, function entry points, state machines or exported callable interfaces appear.
No error handling or runtime behaviour beyond the duplicate 0x360c alias is described.

findings.text: The routed fragments define Intel PCI device identifiers as fixed 16 bit numeric values attached to symbolic names for device matching. Each name denotes one stable hexadecimal identifier, covering host bridges, memory controllers, I/O hubs, LPC bridges, audio, graphics, accelerators and interconnect blocks. Values are ABI facts rather than computed results.

Two distinct names share the same numeric identifier 0x360c, namely the FBD CNB function and the I7300 error function, so matching logic must treat them as aliases for one device value rather than distinct devices.
The 5 series 3400 LPC identifiers form an inclusive numeric interval bounded below by the MIN name at 0x3b00 and above by the MAX name at 0x3b1f, so valid LPC values in that family span that range.
